latest.notes:
Replace Audio no longer takes a file another element is using.

• Pointing one element at a file that already belongs to a different element left that other element with no audio — its file was renamed into place for the first one. Avvio now refuses and names the element that owns the file, so you can delete the duplicate first and then replace.
• Nothing is changed when it refuses.

If you've already hit this, the audio wasn't deleted — it was renamed. The Library's missing-audio strip lists every element now pointing at nothing, so you can see exactly which are affected.

Includes v0.5.83: a replacement already inside the station folder is renamed into place rather than duplicated.
